headlines.title: Putin orders 72-hour ceasefire in Kyiv
headlines.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin ordered a 72-hour pause in strikes on Kyiv, as U.S. envoys are in Moscow for talks. Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are expected to make their first visit to Kyiv tomorrow. NBC News’ Richard Engel reports from inside Ukraine.

headlines.title: Millions under severe weather threat over Labor Day weekend
headlines.description: Nearly 10 million people are facing severe weather threats over the holiday weekend, including torrential downpours, powerful winds and huge hail. In the Detroit area, tens of thousands are without power after storms there. NBC News’ Liz Kreutz reports.

headlines.title: Halloween Chocolatey Eyeballs Candy Recalled Over Allergy Risks
headlines.description: New Jersey candy company Little Temptations has recalled their popular “chocolatey eyeballs” because of undeclared milk allergens. The candy is sold at major retailers including Marshalls, TJ Maxx, and Home Goods in 13 states.

headlines.title: U.S. envoys Witkoff and Kushner meet with Zelenskyy in Kyiv after peace talks in Moscow
headlines.description: President Donald Trump’s envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are meeting with Ukraine’s Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Kyiv, a day after they met with Russia’s Vladimir Putin in Moscow to discuss plans toward ending the war in Ukraine.

headlines.title: Hurricane Lowell threatens Hawaiian Islands with life-threatening surf
headlines.description: Hurricane Lowell is expected to create life-threatening conditions even as it is forecast to pass just west of the major Hawaiian islands by Monday night.

headlines.title: Trump-aligned super PAC to spend $10 million in Texas Senate race
headlines.description: MAGA Inc., the super PAC aligned with President Donald Trump, plans to spend $10 million dollars in the Texas Senate race, according to a report filed with the FEC.

headlines.title: ‘Evil Dead’ star Bruce Campbell says he has five years to live after cancer diagnosis
headlines.description: Actor Bruce Campbell said he has five years to live amid treatment for cancer.
